name: Mixed basics: real game film
blurb: Jason Preston reviews players' own game film: swing it, take what's there, and drive with good angles.

JP-LIVE1.t: NBA Player Breaks Down YOUR Film

JP-LIVE2.t: NBA Player Breaks Down YOUR Film

JP-LIVE3.t: NBA Player Breaks Down YOUR Film

m.title: Attacking from the wing
m.q: You're attacking and the defense is collapsing. Go up, or swing it?
m.ans: He never once looked at the corner, and it was open.
m.quote: He never once thought to swing it to this corner. Like that was never an option. Even here like it was it was never an option. It was always go up.

m.title: Into the paint again
m.q: You're getting into the paint again. Where's the open man?
m.ans: The corner has been open the whole time. He wants to shoot it, but he can't this time.
m.quote: Like corner's been open. And he he wants to shoot this, but he can't this time.

m.title: Right read, which pass?
m.q: Your teammate is open. The defender between you isn't moving. What kind of pass?

choices.t: A pass around the defender's hands
A chest pass straight past him

m.ans: The read is right, but a chest pass right in front of someone gets picked off against better players. Throw it around his hands.
m.quote: Like this is not the right pass. You should never be able to throw a chest pass right in front of someone. He just look at this guy's not doing anything.

m.title: Two in front of you
m.q: Two defenders are in front of you and there's nowhere to drive. What now?

choices.t: Be patient and let the play develop
Pick up the ball and look to pass

m.ans: Let the play develop. When the clear-out comes, then you go.
m.quote: Cuz there's two people here. There's not really anywhere to drive. Kind of got to let the play develop a little bit. Okay, clear out. Now, now, now this is where we're going.

m.title: Pass ahead at half court
m.q: You're passing ahead at half court. Bounce or chest?
m.ans: A bounce pass at half court is slower and lets a defender get in the play. Throw a chest pass.
m.quote: There's a little detail. Don't throw a bounce pass here. Not at half court. This is a slower pass, which is allowing somebody to get in the play.

m.title: Catch in the corner
m.q: The ball gets swung to you in the corner. Your man is standing in the paint. Shoot or pump fake?
m.ans: A guy standing in the paint means it's a shot every time, especially if you're a shooter.
m.quote: There's no pump faking. There's no pump faking. The guy standing in the paint is a shot every time. Especially if you're a shooter.

m.title: He's overplaying you
m.q: Your man is overplaying you to one side. Where do you attack?

choices.t: His top leg, then read the big
Away from him, to the open space

m.ans: Attack the top leg, then read the big who picks you up and make the pass.
m.quote: Defender wants to sell him right, we attack top leg. Read big who picks him up, pass was made perfectly.

m.title: Which way do you drive?
m.q: You're driving past your man. Do you drive to the open space or straight into him?

choices.t: Straight into him, with your shoulder

m.ans: The open space lets him time your shot and contest it. Drive into him so your shoulder makes contact and forces his hips open, and he's out of the play.
m.quote: So, like this is the open space, right? But, you don't want to drive here. You want to drive this way.

m.title: Catch on the break
m.q: You catch it on the break with your bigs and wings running. First thing you do?

choices.t: Catch and look up the floor

m.ans: Catch and look. As the defender comes closer to you, that's the pass to the runner.
m.quote: Like see the first thing he does he catches it and dribbles it should really be catch look.
cast: YOU · catching it on the break

m.title: All four come to you
m.q: You drive and all four defenders come to you. What's open?

choices.t: Swing it out to one of your three teammates

m.ans: When all four come to you, someone is open. Swing it out.
m.quote: But just noticing that like all four come to him and then swinging out to one of these three.

m.title: Help side about to come
m.q: Help side is about to be active. Which way are you going?

choices.t: Drive at the help, and kick it if he comes

m.ans: Drive it. If he helps, the man he left has a wide open shot.
m.quote: me, I see something like this, I'm driving here. He helps, wide open shot here.

m.title: Single-side tag
m.q: You come off a ball screen and there's one tag defender on that side. Who do you read?
m.ans: Read what the tag has to do. If he helps, the corner is wide open. Here he stays, so beat the big on the outside.
m.quote: We're just reading what this guy has to do. He helps in corners wide open, but we beat the big on the outside.

m.title: First step off the screen
m.q: You're coming off the ball screen. Where should your first step go?
m.ans: His first step went to the sideline. Get a better angle and go downhill.
m.quote: I'd say your angles can be better. Like here, you're coming off this ball screen and your first step is like to the sideline.

m.title: He goes under twice
m.q: Your man goes under the screen. You re-screen and he goes under again. What do you do?
m.ans: In the league it's a rule: under once, re-screen, under twice, automatic shot.
m.quote: As a rule in the league, goes under once, re-screen, goes under twice, automatic shot.

m.title: Into the ball screen
m.q: You're coming into the ball screen and the screener slips out. What's open?

choices.t: A bounce pass to the slipping screener

m.ans: The screener is the open one. Instead of spinning into where he's rolling, throw him a bounce pass around the defender for a layup.
m.quote: This one's interesting here because the guy who's setting the screen is the one that's open.

m.title: After the ball fake
m.q: Good ball fake. Now which way do you bump?

choices.t: Toward the top of the key, for a wide open three
Back the way you came, toward the defender

m.ans: He bumped back toward the defender and let him back in the play. Bumping toward the top of the key is a wide open three.
m.quote: If he bumps this way to the top of the key, it's a wide open three. We want to work smarter, not harder.

m.title: Drive, then help comes
m.q: You drive and a helper comes. Force it, or one more?

choices.t: Make the one more pass to the shooter

m.ans: As soon as the help comes, don't force it. Make the one more pass.
m.quote: As soon as this guy helps like he's not going to go force it. He immediately makes the one more pass to the shooter.

m.title: He keeps backing up
m.q: You're driving and looking for contact, but your man keeps backing up. What now?
m.ans: If he won't let you make contact and read off him, take the shot.
m.quote: But if you're going to keep backing up if you're going to keep backing up though and and not allow me to make contact and make a read off of you, then I'll just shoot.
